title: Fomo Kernel Answer Provenance (issue #414, Wave A)
description: The semantically-richer --agent-case claim envelope engine/answer_provenance.py::validate_agent_case checks (the readable contract; the module holds the enforcement, the same 'no jsonschema dependency' posture every other schema file in this directory already states about its own hand-rolled checker). This is deliberately a NEW, standalone schema, not an edit to pre-trade-consultation.schema.json's own $defs.claim: that shape is additionalProperties:false and has no room for the anchor/source/as_of/worsens fields a provenance-checkable claim needs. Reconciling the two -- whether pre-trade-consultation.schema.json's claim $defs is widened to this shape, versioned, or left as a stricter subset -- is Wave B's integration decision (issue #414's Wave allocation comment), not this module's. Every field a claim carries beyond 'claim' and 'provenance' depends on which provenance it declares; see the three $defs below.

for.description: Case FOR the trade. Never empty once agent_case is sent at all (owner ruling 2026-07-27, restated by #414: a one-sided submission is refused).

against.description: Case AGAINST the trade. Never empty -- see 'for'.

engineFactClaim.description: A claim that is, verbatim, the frozen engine result. Must mechanically resolve, and must quote every number exactly -- see answer_provenance.py's _resolve_anchor / _numeric_claim_matches.

claim.description: One sentence, the caller's own words.

anchor.description: Dot-separated path into the frozen {basis, consequence, rule_collisions} bundle a consultation freezes (schemas/pre-trade-consultation.schema.json's own basis/consequence/rule_collisions properties). rule_collisions is addressed by rule_id, e.g. 'rule_collisions.rule-1.worsens', not by list position. Must resolve to exactly one scalar fact -- a path naming a container (an object or array) does not resolve.

worsens.description: Required, and must equal the frozen value exactly, exactly when anchor targets a rule_collisions[...].state or .worsens field whose frozen state is already_over and whose worsens is not null (both already_over and worsens != null must hold; see consequence.py's own module docstring on why the two are independent axes). Forbidden on every other engine_fact claim.

publicFactClaim.description: A claim sourced from outside both the engine and the user. source + as_of is the same provenance anchor condition-slot.schema.json's own observation $defs already cites this issue for, and the pair price-feed.schema.json already uses -- not source_ref/observed_at, a second name for the same idea this module deliberately avoids introducing.

source.description: The named external source, e.g. a filing, a press release, a recognized market-data provider.

as_of.description: The date the cited fact describes (or was read), an ISO date.

judgmentClaim.description: The agent's own reasoning, or a report of what the user said -- never presented as engine fact or public fact (issue #414: 'a user statement may only be described as what the user stated at that time; it is not promoted to an external fact').
